scientific_note: The comparator performs one-time response-partition duplicate removal at the root of every benchmark state, a stronger per-state analogue of whole-dataset duplicate-feature preprocessing. Descendant-specific canonicalisation still solved ten additional states under an equal 250,000-expansion budget and reduced exact expansions by 16.1x median and 54.5x p90, with zero optimum mismatch whenever both solvers completed. This isolates the contribution from known global duplicate-feature removal.
